manifest.scope: Vocabulary/template/registration oracles and optional synthetic CUDA fixtures; no full model inference

peak_scope: sampled system-wide usage includes other processes; not an allocation guarantee

result.scope: synthetic direct CUDA matrix/router operations; no full MiMo graph, model weights, pipeline or inference
result.tolerance_policy: declared before execution: F32 NMSE<=1e-10 and abs<=5e-5; BF16/quant (including activation rounding) NMSE<=1e-4 and abs<=0.02; router exact IDs, NMSE<=1e-10 abs<=2e-6
result.cpu_role: explicit test oracle only; CUDA graph executed directly without a fallback scheduler
